data.action: 独自跨坐床褥，身体前倾，双手撑在自己的膝头
data.description: 黎明前的军官寝室，成年蕾娜独自跨坐在床褥上，仅保留白色过膝袜与吊带。双手撑在自己的膝头，颈侧 Para-RAID 发出幽蓝微光。
data.lighting: 耳机幽蓝辉光与窗外微明星光勾勒汗珠轮廓
data.nsfwProse: Completely unclothed apart from white thigh-high stockings fastened to delicate garter straps, her bare breasts and hips are softly outlined in the cool blue light.
data.promptProse: Seen from a low angle in a quiet officer's bedroom before dawn, Lena leans forward astride the rumpled bedsheets with both hands steadying on her knees as faint starlight meets the pale blue glow at her collar.
data.title: 芙拉蒂蕾娜 · 同调状态下的主控跨坐骑乘
data.animaCaption: Holding a solitary straddling pose atop her predawn quarters bed with both palms braced on her knees, she wears only white thigh-high stockings, garter straps, and her neck-worn Para-RAID glowing soft blue against the window starlight.
